item.title: Caddo Parish K-9 Unit receives upgraded field uniforms through foundation support
item.description: The Caddo Parish Sheriff’s Office announced its K-9 Unit is now outfitted with newly issued uniforms designed specifically for field operations in wooded and rural environments. item.title: Shreveport issues voluntary boil advisory following water main break
item.description: The City of Shreveport Government has issued a voluntary boil advisory for the entire Shreveport Water System following a transmission main break and resulting loss of water pressure. According to the city’s Water and Sewerage Department, residents are advised to boil water for one full minute at a rolling boil before consuming it, making ice, brushing teeth … Continue reading Shreveport issues voluntary boil advisory following water main break

item.title: Shreveport water main break triggers public health emergency, widespread school closures
item.description: Journal Staff A break in a 42-inch concrete transmission main at Shreveport’s primary water treatment facility near Cross Lake has triggered a citywide public health emergency, forcing school closures, government shutdowns and a boil water advisory affecting the entire city, officials said Monday. Mayor Tom Arceneaux said the city faces “about a week of crisis.” … Continue reading Shreveport water main break triggers public health emergency, widespread school closures
